verses.1: A spirit carried me away, and he brought me to the gate of the Old Temple. There were forty-five men at the gate. I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azur, and Pletyahu son of Benyahu, the leaders of the people.
verses.2: And he said to Adam, “These are the people who think and give bad advice in this city.”
verses.3: The words “They do not live near the daughters of houses” are nonsense. We are just talking about things that don’t exist in reality.
verses.4: Therefore, a human son was born to them.
verses.5: And the Spirit of the LORD fell on me, and He said to me, “Speak thus: ‘As the LORD has said, so shall you speak. You said to the house of Israel, “I will know your secrets.”’
verses.6: You have become too numerous in this city, and you are filling it with chaos.
verses.7: Therefore, as Adonai Yehovah said: “Your graves will be opened up. Those who are buried there will be raised from their graves, and you will be brought out of them.”
verses.8: May your sins be destroyed, and may I bring punishment upon you, says the Lord God.
verses.9: And I brought you out from her presence, and I placed you in the hands of foreigners. I judged you accordingly.
verses.10: In that year, they will fall upon the borders of Israel. I will rescue you from them, and you will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.11: She will not be your judge. Instead, you will be among her people, and she will lead you to the borders of Israel. Then she will judge you.
verses.12: And know that I, the LORD, have laws that you do not follow; and I have judgments that you do not obey. You act according to the laws of the nations around you.
verses.13: And he became a prophet, and Paltiyaahu, his son, died. I wept upon his face. I cried out in a loud voice, “Ah! Adonai Yehovah, you who do all things, you who create everything that belongs to Israel.”
verses.14: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.15: You are children of Adam; you are my brothers. You are the people of your redemption. And all the houses of Israel—those who were told by the people of Jerusalem to go away from God’s presence—this land has been given to them as a heritage.
verses.16: Therefore, say this: “O Adonai YHWH, you have scattered them among the nations, and you have made them live in various lands. But now, they will become a holy place for you, in those lands where they once lived.”
verses.17: Therefore, I say this: “Oh Lord Yahweh, I have gathered you together from all the nations and from all the lands where you were scattered. I have given you the land of Israel.”
verses.18: And they came and removed all her decorations and all her burdens from her.
verses.19: And I will give them a new heart, and a new spirit I will give them within their midst. And I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh, and I will give them a heart of flesh.
verses.20: So that they may follow My laws, keep My judgments, and carry them out. Then I will be their God, and they will be My people.
verses.21: And their hearts, with all their thoughts and desires, shall follow their own paths. I have given them that, O Lord Jehovah.
verses.22: And the cherubim raised their wings and their bodies, and they glorified the God of Israel above them.
verses.23: And the glory of the LORD rose above the city, and he stood on the mountain that was before the city.
verses.24: And the Spirit carried me away, and brought me down to the bottom of the valley. It was a vision in the light of God’s glory. And the vision that I saw appeared before me.
verses.25: And I will tell the people all the words of Jehovah that I have seen.
